CompetitorInfo.description: Structured information for an identified competitor entity.

name.description: Formal name of the competitor organization or product.
name.title: Name

category.description: Competitor category classification (e.g., Direct, Indirect, Emerging, Incumbent).
category.title: Category

description.description: Short summary description of the competitor's market position and value prop.
description.title: Description

target_market.description: Target customer segment or geographic market served by this competitor.
target_market.title: Target Market

primary_offering.description: Core product, platform, or service offered by this competitor.
primary_offering.title: Primary Offering

CompetitorInfo.title: CompetitorInfo

description: Structured Pydantic schema for CompetitorDiscoveryAgent output.

direct_competitors.description: List of direct competitors offering similar core solutions.
direct_competitors.title: Direct Competitors

indirect_competitors.description: List of indirect competitors solving similar problems through alternative methods.
indirect_competitors.title: Indirect Competitors

emerging_competitors.description: List of early-stage startups or emerging market entrants.
emerging_competitors.title: Emerging Competitors

market_leaders.description: Established market leaders and dominant industry incumbents.
market_leaders.title: Market Leaders

startup_challengers.description: High-growth startup challengers disrupting the sector.
startup_challengers.title: Startup Challengers

alternative_solutions.description: Non-software, manual, or legacy alternative solutions used by customers.
alternative_solutions.title: Alternative Solutions

competition_intensity.description: Overall market competition intensity (e.g. Low, Moderate, High, Fierce).
competition_intensity.title: Competition Intensity

major_competitor_count.description: Estimated count of major active competitors in the primary segment.
major_competitor_count.title: Major Competitor Count

confidence_score.description: Confidence score rating strictly between 0.0 and 1.0.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

citations.description: Source URLs backing the claims above, when external research (Tavily/Exa/Zyte) was supplied in the prompt. Optional and defaults empty so this schema stays backward compatible with LLM-only reasoning when no research bundle is available.
citations.title: Citations
